Claude-1.desc: Cosmetic double-space in Button.tsx:68's className template literal when fullWidth is falsy (extra space between disabled:opacity-50 and the variant class) - no functional/visual effect, HTML class attribute and toHaveClass both tolerate it
Claude-1.disposition: fixed: user chose to fix - one-line cosmetic cleanup while already touching Button.tsx

Codex-1.desc: Login card geometry still doesn't match mockup-1a: outer wrapper's max-w-sm caps the card at 384px while the mockup measures ~404px wide, and Card retains the generic 14px rounded-card radius instead of the already-declared-but-unused 16px --radius-login-card token. Confirmed by pixel measurement: mockup card=404px (x=59-462 @ 522px canvas), implementation card=382px (x=70-451), consistent across 6 sampled rows.
Codex-1.disposition: fixed: user chose to fix - widen wrapper to measured mockup width (~406px) and add Card radius='login' using --radius-login-card

Codex-2.desc: The new visual tests permit several acceptance-breaking implementations to remain green: removing min-h-screen, the field gap, all subtext classes, or w-full only-while-busy would still pass; the skip-link test checks for sr-only/focus:not-sr-only class tokens without asserting actual focused-state visibility (computed style/visible bounding box).
Codex-2.disposition: accepted: user chose to accept as-is - underlying behavior already covered by axe e2e scans + manual screenshot comparison; tightening every assertion is disproportionate for an S-size visual fix

G4.note: reviews: evidence/reviews/g4-claude.md (fresh loop-reviewer subagent) + evidence/reviews/g4-codex.txt (Codex CLI, fresh thread) + evidence/reviews/g4-codex-confirm.md (Codex fix confirmation, same thread). retro.outcome: What the user corrected: nothing mid-flight - user answered the three finding-disposition questions (fix Codex-1, accept Codex-2, fix Claude-1) as posed. What reviewers caught that an earlier phase should have: the card-width/radius mismatch (Codex-1) should have been caught during my own Frame-phase root-cause read - I read theme.css and noted --color-canvas-login and --radius-login-card were unused tokens 'declared for exactly this', but didn't follow through and check the token was actually WIRED UP once I added the wrapper; I eyeballed the round-1 screenshot as 'nearly a pixel match' instead of measuring it. Only Codex's independent read caught the quantifiable 22px/radius gap. Lesson for this skill: when a mockup screenshot is available, G3's design-track note (design-compare pairs) should be treated as load-bearing even at S/honor-system - a pixel measurement (Pillow/sips or equivalent) costs one command and catches what eyeballing a downscaled screenshot misses. Where this playbook didn't answer: the codex CLI's exact flag syntax (codex exec -s <mode> resume --last <prompt>, not resume --last -s <mode>) and the prettier-plugin-tailwindcss quirk of trimming whitespace across template-literal interpolation boundaries (silently breaking a conditional Tailwind class every time --write ran) aren't documented anywhere in the loop docs or this repo's CLAUDE.md - worth a note in codex-contract.md and a repo convention (array+filter+join for conditional Tailwind classes) respectively.
